description:
NSFW mode reliability improvements:

- Bind each NSFW button to the navigation screen held by Reddit's original click callback.
- Reverse the displayed mode even while the account getter lags behind an update.
- Avoid retaining the fallback navigation screen indefinitely and log missing screen/activity failures.

Verified with focused JVM regressions and an authenticated Android emulator using all 18 upstream Morphe v1.46.0 defaults plus the three custom patches. Home, profile-tab, and background/resume toggle checks passed without crashes. The reported intermittent long-session failure was not reproduced; this release addresses demonstrated failure paths.

Reddit 2026.14.0 remains the supported version. Refresh this source in Morphe Manager and repatch with the usual upstream patches.
